race.comment: EUROPEAN (4) knuckled down strongly to get within 0.6 lengths of the winner in second last start over 900m at this track on debut. Will be better with that race experience now under the belt and is sure to go well again. The well-related AERIALIZE (11) (half to G1 winner Capital Gain) is a two-start maiden who returned last time and finished fourth at Narromine over 800m, beaten 1.2 lengths. Strips fitter now and gets a great chance to break her maiden status. DANCE THE BOOGIE (12) finished ninth, beaten 6 lengths, when resuming from a spell last start over 1000m at Pakenham Synthetic. Should progress from that last outing and poses a genuine threat. HE XIANGU (6) could only manage to finish seventh, beaten 3.5 lengths, at her latest appearance over 1100m at Wodonga. Gets McDougall on board and appeals as a top-four contender.
